answer: Random beacon checks plus a compute heartbeat block fake identities. Each agent posts a 300-unit bond and proves work hourly; the beacon samples 10% for a check, and failures lose the bond. A pigment mark tags each heartbeat, so one record cannot be copied to many accounts. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 300,000 units, far more than stolen votes earn. Honest agents pay once, pass light as a zephyr, and trade in the oasis undiluted.
